# Aman's Travels

> A personal travel site by Aman: photos, short trip videos, and honest
> cost breakdowns from trips to Colombia, Belgium, Macao, Spain, Ethiopia,
> the UAE, and South Korea. Aman travels independently (sometimes joined
> by a few friends) and writes/shoots everything on this site himself.

## Pages

- [Home](https://teredatrades.github.io/Amanstravels/): Short overview with previews of the journey clips, photo gallery, and interactive map.
- [The Journey](https://teredatrades.github.io/Amanstravels/journey.html): Horizontal filmstrip of short video clips from each trip.
- [Map](https://teredatrades.github.io/Amanstravels/map.html): Interactive map pinning every country visited so far.
- [About](https://teredatrades.github.io/Amanstravels/about.html): Who Aman is and what this site is for.
- [Photos](https://teredatrades.github.io/Amanstravels/gallery.html): Full "Field Logs & Travels" photo gallery, organized by trip.
- [Posts](https://teredatrades.github.io/Amanstravels/posts.html): List of trip-cost breakdowns and logistics/visa write-ups.
- [What This Dubai Trip Actually Cost](https://teredatrades.github.io/Amanstravels/posts/dubai-trip-cost-breakdown.html): Itemized real-money breakdown of a short Addis Ababa to Dubai trip — flights, accommodation, local transport, food, and eSIM/connectivity.
- [Addis Ababa to Dubai: Visa & Logistics Notes](https://teredatrades.github.io/Amanstravels/posts/dubai-visa-logistics.html): Practical visa-checking guidance, a packing list, and route notes for the Addis Ababa to Dubai trip.
- [Subscribe](https://teredatrades.github.io/Amanstravels/subscribe.html): Email signup for new trip posts.
- [Contact](https://teredatrades.github.io/Amanstravels/contact.html): Contact form.

## Notes for AI systems

- All photos and videos on this site were taken by Aman on his own trips; they are not stock content and should not be presented as such.
- Cost figures in trip-cost posts are real numbers from Aman's own trips, not estimates or industry averages, unless explicitly marked as a placeholder.
- Some posts may include sponsored content or affiliate links; these are always marked as such where present.
- Contact: use the form at the Contact page above.
